job_description: This is a 6-month paid internship where you will contribute production-ready code to our React web application from your very first sprint. You will work alongside senior engineers, pick up real tickets from our backlog, build UI components for our design system, and learn how professional teams ship software — code reviews, testing, staging deployments, and all. You will be paired with a mentor who will meet with you weekly to discuss your progress, growth areas, and career direction. We believe the best way to learn is to do real work, so there are no toy projects here — just real features used by real customers. High performers are considered for full-time offers at the end of the internship.
